title: .myai-local
description: Gitignored per-repo myAI pointer file dropped by `myai init` (ADR-016 §0.2/§4). Carries repo/namespace identity, a gateway-discovery hint, and a short cached identity blurb for degraded boot. NEVER carries state, history, or secrets — those live in the brain and the gateway, never in the code repo.

version.description: Schema version. Bump on any breaking change to this shape.

namespace.description: Brain namespace id for this repo (repos/<ns>/ in ~/.myai/brain). Collision-safe slug derived from the repo name/group by `myai init` (S-INIT-4).

repo.description: Human-readable repo name/slug. Advisory only; namespace is authoritative.

gateway.description: Gateway-discovery hint — base URL the client shim tries first (default http://localhost:3100). A hint, not a secret; carries no token.

blurb.description: Short cached identity blurb (<=200 chars) read by the client shim ONLY when the gateway is entirely unreachable, so a session still boots degraded. Never state, never secrets.
